To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The EVP and employer brand (internal and external) are significantly higher in organizations where there is a well-developed employer branding strategy.
The EVP is a significant contributor to the employer brand.
the employer brand and the EVP are closely aligned and that the employer brand, EVP and organizational identity have a significant impact on employer branding.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the EVP in the creation of the employer brand.
the relationship between the employer brand and other organizational identities and how this relationship is affected by the existence and development of an employer branding strategy.
the relationship between the employer identity and other organizational identities and the implications for the development of the EVP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a company's employer brand is a function of its EVP and other related identity elements, which together form a'multiple identity' which is a function of a company's employer branding strategy.
the EVP is the central component of employer branding.
the EVP is a significant factor in the development of employer brand, but it is the strength of the EVP that is important, rather than the existence of the EVP per se.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the employer brand is a composite of all the identities of the organization and that the EVP has a significant role to play in the development of a strong and effective employer brand.
a well developed employer brand, with a strong EVP, is a result of a well developed employer identity and branding strategy, which in turn is based on a well developed corporate identity and brand.
a well developed employer value proposition is the key to developing a strong employer brand.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the employer branding process is a key determinant of the EVP, which, in turn, is a key driver of the employer brand.
the development of a well defined EVP is a key element in the development of a strong employer brand.
the EVP is not an independent variable, but is a product of the multiple identities of the organization and its products.
